note: Offline resource cache, not an API response. Each body is one application/swe+json observation; context supplies its parent stream. System URIs and local field definitions are project identifiers. The two temperatures and flags are historical station values.

recordSchema.label: Station air temperature: 15-minute mean of five-second samples

fields.name: stamp
fields.label: Station time marking the averaging period, not result availability

fields.name: window
fields.label: Nominal averaging interval (station stamp treated as closing time)

fields.name: qc
fields.label: Operator quality flag for mean air temperature
fields.description: F_ATemp verbatim, including any codes and spacing; never the row flag or another quantity's flag.

fields.name: probe
fields.label: Sensing System UID inferred from the station's installation history
fields.description: Not the station, logger or product datasheet. Omit when a single physical probe cannot be attributed.
